title: I analysed 20 years of my chats
summary: A personal data analysis project where the author examined 20 years of their chat message history to gain insights into their communication patterns and relationships, presented as a self-reflective journey to understand their friendships.
problem_solved: Helps individuals understand their long-term communication patterns and social relationships through retrospective chat analysis.
why_valuable: Demonstrates how personal data can reveal behavioral insights about social connections and provides a replicable methodology for self-analytics enthusiasts.
